commits.author: Philip Riecks
commits.message:
pin MockServer testcontainer to the maintained mockserver/mockserver image (#244)

The review-microshed-testing integration tests used the deprecated no-arg
MockServerContainer() constructor, which defaults to the legacy
jamesdbloom/mockserver Docker Hub namespace. Pin the image explicitly to the
maintained mockserver/mockserver repository via DockerImageName, kept at the
same 5.5.4 tag so it stays aligned with the mockserver-client-java dependency.

Note: the nightly failure that surfaced this
(https://github.com/rieckpil/blog-tutorials/actions/runs/30150668359) was a
transient Docker Hub registry timeout ("Status 500 ... registry-1.docker.io ...
Client.Timeout exceeded"), not a missing image - the legacy tag still resolves.
This change is the durable hardening: it moves off the deprecated image
namespace and constructor so the module no longer depends on the abandoned
jamesdbloom repository.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
